$comment: Central confidence configuration (BRD section 9, FR-030). These values MUST NOT be duplicated anywhere else in the codebase (Rule 3). Business tunes them in the Dataverse Configuration table after pilot testing; this file is the versioned seed and the source used by the test suite.

confidence.$comment: BRD section 9: >=0.90 high (automatic), 0.75-0.89 medium (restricted), <0.75 human review.

scenarioOverrides.$comment: Per-scenario overrides. SC-04 and SC-08 are machine-generated and near-deterministic; SC-09 is judgement-heavy. Seeded at the BRD defaults - tune after the pilot (Q-25).

penalties.$comment: AD-006. Multiplicative penalties applied to the model's self-reported confidence before banding. A model's self-report is an input, not a verdict.

programEvidence.$comment: AD-004. Weighted evidence model for FIT/FLO determination (BRD section 8). Aggregate score at or above programConfidenceThreshold assigns the programme; otherwise UNKNOWN and Rule R-1 fires (route to BOTH owners).
programEvidence.$comment2: genericKeywordOnlyCeiling caps programme confidence when generic keywords are the ONLY evidence, structurally enforcing FR-028 (do not infer FIT/FLO with high confidence on insufficient evidence).

corroboration.$comment: AD-006. Gives the medium band a defined, testable meaning rather than leaving 'restricted automation' undefined.
